property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always makes external calls using the selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) so the callee's recorded calledSelector equals that bytes4; the mutant uses a different selector (transfer(address,uint256)) and thus will cause the recorded selector to differ for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the computed selector to a different function signature so the external calls invoke a different selector and may return different success values.
